rationale: As the senior Justice in the majority, Sotomayor is best positioned to keep the coalition together around the Arbaugh/Henderson/Boechler/Santos-Zacaria clear-statement approach while distinguishing Stone and Bowles. A Roberts dissent is likely to emphasize statutory stare decisis and reliance, with some chance of a separate Thomas writing to press a more categorical jurisdictional/anti-tolling view.
